_comment: Hooks written by hand for clips whose topic could not be recovered from the TikTok
description or its hashtags. Read off the burned-in caption in a mid-point frame
(ffmpeg -ss <dur/2> -vframes 1), which is where the lesson word always sits.
Written as SEARCH QUERIES in Peninsular Spanish, because the title's only job is to
match the 'cómo se dice / cómo se pronuncia' SERP where these videos can rank.
No barrio names here — geo belongs in the description, never the title.
build_captions.py reads this file and prefers it over the auto-seeded hook.
